description: This file contains unit tests for the class FileBasedAuthenticationService. It verifies various behaviors such as token issuance, authorization, and credential verification, using the JUnit and Vertx testing frameworks.

classes.name: FileBasedAuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the FileBasedAuthenticationService class, containing multiple test cases verifying authentication and token behaviors.

methods.name: loadPermissions
methods.description: Static setup method to load permissions from a JSON file and initialize the authentication service.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainFailsForMissingUsername
methods.description: Test that verifies failure when username is missing.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainFailsForMissingPassword
methods.description: Test that verifies failure when password is missing.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainSucceedsForMatchingPassword
methods.description: Test that verifies success when correct credentials are provided.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainGrantsAuthorizationId
methods.description: Test that verifies authorization identity is granted correctly.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainRefusesAuthorizationId
methods.description: Test that verifies refusal to grant an unauthorized identity.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainRefusesNonExistingAuthorizationId
methods.description: Test that verifies behavior for non-existing authorization identity.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalFailsForMissingSubjectDn
methods.description: Test that verifies failure when subject DN is missing in external verification.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalGrantsCommonName
methods.description: Test that verifies token issuance when external verification provides a common name.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalGrantsAuthorizationId
methods.description: Test that verifies external authorization identity grants.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalRefusesNonExistingAuthorizationId
methods.description: Test for external verification with non-existent authorization identity.

methods.name: testVerifyExternalRefusesAuthorizationId
methods.description: Test that verifies appropriate handling of authorization IDs in external verification.

methods.name: testVerifyPlainAddsAuthoritiesForOperations
methods.description: Test that verifies authorities are added to token for operation permissions.
